question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Reckon
solution:
The correct answer is: **Think**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Reckon **means to calculate or estimate, but it can also mean to think or suppose. (अनुमान करना)
 
• **Think **means the process of using one's mind to consider, analyze, reflect upon, or generate ideas. (सोचना)
 
• Synonyms for "reckon" include "believe", "consider", and "judge".
 
 
• **Example**: *I reckon it will take about an hour to finish this project.*
 
 

*​*Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Relieve **means to alleviate or ease someone's pain or discomfort. (राहत देना)
 
• **Release **means to set free or let go. (मुक्त करना)
 
• **Terminate **means to end or conclude something. (बर्खास्त)
